latest_release.body:
## [10.1.2](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/compare/v10.1.1...v10.1.2) (2026-11-06)

### Bug Fixes

* update dependency conventional-commits-parser to v7.1.3 ([#4561](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/issues/4561)) ([9e351cb](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/commit/9e351cbc9f5d5946189efeb94abe7d54954236a2))
* update dependency execa to v10.2.0 ([#4564](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/issues/4564)) ([b8d94ff](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/commit/b8d94ff5a95597322c0cf13bfaeaf6b91a2f5e0f))
* update dependency inquirer to v14.2.5 ([#4554](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/issues/4554)) ([46aaf07](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/commit/46aaf07cd40761b488a260ac97b17e55f0b1b77f))
* update dependency js-yaml to v5.5.0 ([#4562](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/issues/4562)) ([bf133ec](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/commit/bf133ec8e26987721d00c216aab18d597198b48e))
* update dependency minimatch to v11 [security] ([#4592](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/issues/4592)) ([dfa96d2](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/commit/dfa96d206d0860f7baa29ec6fe160469b5ee7918))

detail.readme_excerpt:
> **Important note: this project [changed stewardship to Nx](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/issues/3121)!** > > **Your favorite tool is alive and well: https://blog.nrwl.io/lerna-5-1-new-website-new-guides-new-lerna-example-repo-distributed-caching-support-and-speed-64d66410bec7**

Lerna is a fast, modern build system for managing and publishing multiple JavaScript/TypeScript packages from the same repository.



A few links to help you get started: - [lerna.js.org: Documentation, Guides, Interactive Tutorials](https://lerna.js.org) - [Getting Started](https://lerna.js.org/docs/getting-started) - [Features](https://lerna.js.org/docs/features) - [Official Nx and Lerna YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@nxdevtools) - [Blog Posts About Lerna and Nx](https://nx.dev/blog)
## Engage with the Core Team and the Community - [Follow Lerna on Twitter](https://twitter.com/lernajs) - [Community Discord, #forum channel](https://go.nx.dev/community) ### Want to help? If you want to file a bug or submit a PR, read up on our [guidelines for contributing](https://github.com/lerna/lerna/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
### Core Team | Victor Savkin | James Henry | Benjamin Cabanes | Juri Strumpflohner
